6, 9, 15, 24, 39, 63,?
questions.solution:
Adding the numbers to their immediate previous number gives the immediate next number in the sequence,

6 + 9 = 15

9 + 15 = 24

15 + 24 = 39

24 + 39 = 63

39 + 63 = 102.

Thus, the next number should be 102.

questions.question: Nine years later, the age of B will be equal to the present age of A. Sum of A's age 3 years later and B's age 4 years ago will be 76. If the age of C is half of the present age of B, then what will be C's age (in years) after 10 years?
questions.solution:
Let the present age of A be ‘x’

Thus, nine years later B’ s age = x

Therefore, present age of B = (x - 9)

According to question,

Sum of A's age 3 years later and B's age 4 years ago is 76

⇒ (x + 3) + {(x - 9) - 4} = 76

⇒ × = 43

Thus, A’ s present age = 43

B’ s present age = 43 - 9 = 34

Given,

The age of C is half of the present age of B ⇒ C’ s present age = 17

Therefore, C’ s age after 10 years = 17 + 10 = 27.

questions.solution:

R - 2 = P

Reverse order → IABPF.

Which one of the following is a component of Food Security System?
questions.solution:
• Buffer stock is a component of the Food Security System.
 
• It is the central stock maintained by the Government of India for various purposes of food security, such as taking care of emergency situations.
 
• Emergency situations can be crop failure or stabilization of prices by way of market intervention.

questions.question: What is the accepted average Calorie requirement for rural area in India?
questions.solution: In 1973, the poverty line was decided to be set as per nutritional intake of the citizens of India. The required amount of calories required for a person in rural area was set at 2400 and for urban at 2100 calories per day.

questions.question: Whose resolution is mandatory to impeach the President of India from his ofﬁce before the completion of his/her term?

options.text: The Speaker of the Lok Sabha
Either of the two houses of the parliament

questions.solution: The process of impeachment of President can start in either of the two houses of the Parliament i.e. Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha. A resolution to impeach the President has to be passed by a two-third majority of the total number of members of the house where impeachment process had begun.

questions.question: How many types of writs are there in the Indian Constitution?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**5**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• There are **5 Writz**__ in the Indian Constitution.
 
• Article 32 of the Indian Constitution has been described as the ‘heart and soul’ of the Indian Constitution by Dr. B. R. Ambedkar.
 
• It gives a citizen the right to approach the Supreme Court to get resorted any of the fundamental rights in case of their violation.
 
• It is also known as; Right to Constitutional Remedies.

 
 

 __Article__
 __Consists of__
 
 

 Article 32
 
 
Right to move the Supreme court for the enforcement of fundamental rights including the writs.

 __
 
• habeas corpus
 
• mandamus
 
• prohibition
 
• certiorari
 
• quo warranto
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Habeas Corpus: This writ is issued to produce a person who has been detained whether in prison or in private custody, before a court and to release him if such detention is found illegal.
 
• Mandamus: The writ of command is issued by supreme or high court when any government, court, corporation, or any public authority has to do a public duty but fails to do so.
 
• Prohibition: It is issued by a higher court to a lower court or tribunal to prevent them from exceeding their jurisdiction.
 
• Certiorari: The writ of certiorari can be issued by the supreme or high court for quashing the order already passed by an inferior court, tribunal or quasi-judicial authority.
 
• Quo-Warranto: The writ of quo-warranto can be issued by the supreme or high court for asking of by what authority or warrant. It is issued by the court to enquire into the legality of a claim of a person to a public office.

questions.question: Who has built the Vijay Stambha (tower of victory) in Chittorgarh?
questions.solution: The Vijaya Stambha is a victory monument which is located inside the premises of Chittorgarh fort in Chittorgarh, Rajasthan. The tower was constructed by the Mewar king, Rana Kumbha, in 1448 to commemorate his victory over the armies of Malwa and Gujarat led by Mahmud Khilji.

questions.question: Who raised the slogan “Swaraj is my birth right and I shall have it”?

questions.question: Auxiliary bud develops into which of the following part of the plant?
questions.solution: The axillary bud is a shoot developed at embryo stage that is located in the axil (the space between the leaf and the branch) of a plant. Each bud has the potential to form shoots, and may be specialized in producing either vegetative or reproductive shoots.

questions.question: Xylem primarily transports which of the following?
questions.solution: Xylem is a transport tissue in vascular plants. Its primary function is to transport water from roots to shoots and leaves. But it also transports Nutrients

questions.question: What is the other name of Galileo's law of inertia?
questions.solution:
Option **2** is correct, i.e. __**Newton's ﬁrst law of motion**__.

__
 
• The other name of Galileo's law of inertia is **Newton's ﬁrst law of motion**__.
 
• Sir Isaac Newton first presented his three laws of motion in **1686**.
 
• His first law states that every object will remain at rest or in uniform motion in a straight line unless compelled to change its state by the action of an external force.
 
• This concept is generally known as inertia.

**Extra information:**

 
• Newton’s First Law of motion- As per the newton’s first law of motion, if any object is in motion, then it will be continuously in motion, if it is in rest then it will be in rest, till any external force is not applied on it. It is also called the law of inertia.
 
• Newton’s Second Law of Motion- The rate of change of momentum of a body is directly proportional to the applied force and takes place in the direction in which the force acts.
 
• Newton’s Third Law of motion- It describes that every action will have an equal and opposite reaction.

questions.question: Which of the following device is best suited for measuring the temperature inside metallurgical furnaces?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Pyrometer. **__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64e177b3c5c5cb81c12b3d5b5ddabaaf474cdad3d6098992ca6592786c8147d6.png] 

 
• **Pyrometers are the temperature measuring devices** used to **detect the object’s temperature** and **electromagnetic radiation emitted** from the object.
 
• **Principle of Working :**
 
 
• It **measures the object’s temperature** by **sensing the heat/radiation emitted** from the object **without making contact with the object.**
 
 
 
• It **records the temperature level **depending upon the** intensity of radiation emitted.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87c1a28e731fadd9279228c1cea2f8e988a3f790bf9ccc89c9b0f02c423b1609.png] 

 
• **The pyrometer has two basic components** like **optical system and detectors** that are** used to measure the surface temperature of the object. **
 
• It is an** example of non- contact measurement.**
 
• **Thermocouple is a temperature-measuring** device** consisting of two wires of different metals joined at each end, **and works on **Seebeck effect.**
 
• **Thermometer **is also an** instrument **for **measuring temperature.**
 
• A **thermistor (or thermal resistor)** is defined as a** type of resistor **whose **electrical resistance varies** with **changes in temperature. **

questions.question: How many numbers are there from 300 to 650 which are completely divisible by both 5 and 7?

⇒ 1st number after 300 which is divisible by 35 = 35 × 9 = 315

Last number which is less than 650 = 35 × 18 = 630

⇒ 630 = 315 + (n - 1)35

⇒ n = 10

∴ there are 10 numbers between 300 and 650 which are divisible by 35

questions.question: If the diameter of a sphere is 14 cm, then what is the surface area (in cm²) of the sphere?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Diameter of sphere = 14 cm

**Formula used:**

Surface area of a sphere = 4πr²

**Calculation:**

Radius = 14/2 = 7 cm

⇒ Surface area = 4 × π × Radius²

⇒ 4 × 22/7 × 49

**∴ Area is 616 cm²**

 After 20% discount price of 1 pen = x(1 – 20/100) = 0.8x

questions.question:

No sooner did I come out of my home to go to the market when it started raining heavily which drenched me completely.

options.text: No sooner did I come out of my home

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**when it started raining heavily**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **'than it started raining heavily' **should be there in place of **'when it started raining heavily'**
 
• If the second event occurs immediately after the first, we can express that idea using the structure no sooner … than.
 
• Note that in this structure no sooner introduces the event that occurred first.
 
 
• **​Examples: **No sooner had I arrived at the station than the train came.

 No sooner had we heard the noise than we rushed to the spot.
 
 
 
• Note that did is also possible in this structure.
 
 
• ​**Example: **No sooner did I arrive at the station than the train came
 
 

**Hence, the sentence can be correctly rewritten as:** *No sooner did I come out of my home to go to market **than** it started raining heavily which drenched me completely.*

questions.question:
The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.

P-But he did not know how to find one at that hour.

Q-It was his first visit to the city and he didn't know where to go.

R-Mohanlal's train was late and it reached Kolkata a little after midnight.

S-He thought he would go to a choultry where he would not have to pay rent.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**RQSP.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **R **introduces a general, independent idea. P, Q and S cannot be used to start the paragraph as they contain ‘he’, ‘his’ and ‘he’ respectively and only** R gives the answer to ‘he’ and ‘his’. Thus, R is the first sentence.**
 
• **Q logically follows R** by highlighting his trip to Kolkata that it was his first trip there.
 
• After reaching Kolkata for the first time, he wanted to go to a choultry, and thus, **sentence S is next in the sequence.**
 
• **Sentence P sums up the entire paragraph** and logically follows the previous three sentences.

**Hence, the sentence can be correctly rearranged as:** *Mohanlal's train was late and it reached Kolkata a little after midnight. It was his first visit to the city and he didn't know where to go. He thought he would go to a choultry where he would not have to pay rent. But he did not know how to find one at that hour.*

questions.question:
The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.

P-And slowly, you reach the pinnacle of self-awareness, experiencing a unity with all life.

Q-If you transform your energy positively, it naturally becomes compassion and love.

R-Once you experientially are a part of everything then nobody needs to teach you morality.

S-Then you can do something to improve the situation, but without anger.

The correct answer is __**QPRS**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of a Sentence Jumble. 
 
• The first statement of a sentence jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, or the starting of an incident
 
• Part Q will be the first sentence because the sentence 'transforming of energy positively, resulting in compassion and love *'* is a universal fact and it is an independent general statement. 
 
• **Part P **mentions the later results of transforming energy positively.
 
• **R further highlights the fact that when one experiences everything** then nobody needs to teach you morality.
 
• **S concludes the paragraph** and logically follows the statements preceding it.

**Hence, the sentence can be correctly arranged as: ***If you transform your energy positively, it naturally becomes compassion and love, and slowly, you reach the pinnacle of self-awareness, experiencing a unity with all life. Once you experientially are a part of everything then nobody needs to teach you morality then you can do something to improve the situation, but without anger.*

questions.question:
**In the following question, a sentence has been given in Active/Passive voice. Out of the four alternatives suggested, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Passive/Active voice.**

Ram was singing a beautiful song for his mother.

options.text: A beautiful song was being sung by Ram for his mother.
A beautiful song was sang by Ram for his mother.
A beautiful song was sung by Ram for his mother.
A beautiful song was sung for his mother by Ram.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 1, i.e. A beautiful song was being sung by Ram for his mother. 

While conversion from active to passive or vice-versa object and subject are interchanged. The correct past participle form of ‘sing’ is ‘sung’. Option 1 grammatically follows the idea as in the sentence it is mentioned that ‘Ram is singing’ i.e. the action is still occurring and has not ended yet. Only option 1, takes into consideration that the action is still going on as ‘being sung’ highlights that the action is still alive. Other options are vague and can be rejected.

questions.question:
**In the following question, a sentence has been given in Direct/Indirect speech. Out of the four alternatives suggested, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Indirect/Direct speech.**

Priya advised me not to go to school the next day.

options.text: "Don't go to school next day" Priya said to me.
"Don't go to school tomorrow" Priya said to me.
Priya said, "Will you not go to school tomorrow?"
Priya told me that, "Don't go to school tomorrow."

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**"Don't go to school tomorrow" Priya said to me**__.

• Reading the given sentence

questions.question: **Job performance is ______ by a number of factors. Motivation alone**
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option1, i.e. affected. 

‘Affected’ means ‘influenced or touched by an external factor’ and thus highlights that there are many factors affecting job performance. Other options also might look correct but we need to mark the most appropriate answer choice among the options and option 1 captures the meaning and sense of the sentence in the best possible manner.

Hence, the sentence can be correctly rewritten as, Job performance is affected by a number of factors. Motivation alone does not lead to increased performance.

questions.question: **motivation and performance. The higher the levels of ability and motivation the ______ the level of performance will be.**
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 1, i.e. higher. 

‘Higher’ represents the degree of comparison of the level of performance. Options 2 can be rejected as ‘larger’ is sued in terms of size whereas ‘higher’ is used in terms of levels. Options 3 and 4 have a negative connotation and thus, can be rejected as the given sentence is positive. Thus, the correct answer is option 1.

Hence, the sentence can be correctly rewritten as, The higher the levels of ability and motivation the higher the level of performance will be.

questions.question: **However, increasing motivation beyond an ______ level**
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4, i.e. optimal.

‘An’ is used before the words starting with a vowel sound. Options 1 and 2 can be thus eliminated. Option 3 cab be rejected as ‘increasing ‘ is already mentioned and if we use ‘increased’ again then it will create

questions.question: **tends to ______ a dysfunctional result**
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3, i.e. produce. 

Option 3, i.e. produce logically fits the blank appropriately. Options 1, 3 and 4 can be eliminated as in the above sentence, nothing is being deduced, introduced or reduced. Thus, the correct answer is option 3.

Hence, the sentence can be correctly rewritten as, However, increasing motivation beyond an optimal level tends to produce a dysfunctional result because it is accompanied by an increased level of anxiety.

questions.question: **because it is ______ by an increased level of anxiety.**
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2, i.e. accompanied. 

Option 1, i.e. ‘abandoned’ means ‘having been deserted or left’ and option 3, ‘affiliated’ means ‘to officially attach or connect (a subsidiary group or a person) to an organization’ can be rejected as they are irrelevant with the given context. Option 4, i.e. ‘amalgamated’ is also incorrect as no mention of any kind of amalgamation is there in the given sentence. Thus, option 2 logically fits the blank well and is the most appropriate answer choice.

Hence, the sentence can be correctly rewritten as, However, increasing motivation beyond an optimal level tends to produce a dysfunctional result because it is accompanied by an increased level of anxiety.
